title: Demo: pH indicator colour-change assay
summary: Add universal indicator to three buffer tubes and record the colour change. Simulated, non-hazardous demo protocol.

steps.description: Pipette 1 mL of pH 4 buffer into tube A, pH 7 into tube B, pH 10 into tube C.
Add 3 drops of universal indicator to each tube.
Gently swirl each tube for 5 seconds.
Dictate the colour of each tube (expected: A red/orange, B green, C blue/purple).
steps.expected_observation: A red/orange, B green, C blue/purple.
